reference.title: OAuth
reference.shortdesc: The OtoSense™ SMS REST API implements the OAuth Client Credential flow

section.p: The OtoSense™ SMS REST API implements the OAuth Client Credential flow
At a high level, the flow has two steps:

ol.li: Your application passes its client credentials in a token request.
OtoSense™ SMS device responds with a bearer token if the credentials are accurate.

section.title: Result
section.p: The API response also provides the time left (in seconds) until the token expires.
